M30 — 2026-10-13
On a lanes run, the first `sofar drive --stop` no longer kills sessions (drive-lanes 7.2): the run launches nothing more and stops after every lane's session, gate and landing finish, which can take up to a session timeout. A second --stop signals the sessions. M4 and M8's kill-at-once holds for serial runs only.
